description: This file defines a Slack outbound channel adapter for a messaging SDK, including functions for sending messages, handling interactive blocks, and applying hooks.

methods.name: loadSlackSendRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the send.runtime module for Slack messaging.

methods.name: resolveRenderedInteractiveBlocks
methods.description: Builds Slack blocks from an interactive reply, returning undefined if none.

methods.name: resolveSlackSendIdentity
methods.description: Resolves an OutboundIdentity object into SlackSendIdentity with username, iconUrl, and iconEmoji.

methods.name: applySlackMessageSendingHooks
methods.description: Runs message sending hooks and allows cancellation or modification of message content.

methods.name: sendSlackOutboundMessage
methods.description: Sends a Slack message with optional media, blocks, and identity, applying hooks and handling cancellation.

methods.name: resolveSlackBlocks
methods.description: Merges existing Slack blocks with interactive reply blocks, enforcing maximum block count.
